summary: Frontend-only visual & interaction verification of the redesigned WorldMapSection (vintage nautical chart aesthetic). Tested at desktop 1440x900, tablet 768x1024 and mobile 390x844. All acceptance criteria met: (1) NO distortion — measured SVG aspect ratio equals viewBox aspect ratio (2.160 = 2.160) on every viewport, and the SVG stays fully inside its container; (2) Vintage chart aesthetic confirmed — outer beige parchment frame with corner ticks, faint dashed graticule, compass rose at bottom-left (visible on sm+, correctly hidden on mobile), dashed expedition arc from Europe → Morocco, terracotta Morocco path; (3) Text legibility — 'Marruecos' chip rendered complete and fully inside its container in all 3 viewports (width 81–92 px, fully on-screen). On desktop/tablet the 5 ocean labels ('Ártico', 'Océano Atlántico', 'Océano Pacífico' x2, 'Océano Índico') render fully (widths 40–127 px, no clipping); on mobile they are correctly hidden via 'hidden md:block'. Click regression: Morocco path, Morocco label and CTA all navigate to /que-ver-en-Marruecos. /geo/countries-110m.json returns 200. Zero console errors / pageerrors.
critical_code_review_comments: WorldMapSection.jsx: ocean label for 'Ártico' is placed at coord [-12, 74] — currently fits inside the cropped viewBox at all tested sizes, but if FIT_H or PAD is ever reduced, that label sits very close to the top edge; consider clamping label y to [PAD, vb.h-PAD] to guarantee it never clips.

Accessibility: the SVG <path> for Morocco has role/tabIndex/aria-label and keyboard handler, and the HTML <button> label is also focusable — good. The CTA <button> below is also accessible. Parity looks solid now.

Performance: ~349 <path> nodes (170 country fills + 170 coastlines + graticule + route + morocco + compass) is fine. The duplicated country-coastline pass could be merged into a single <path> with fill+stroke to halve node count if the section ever becomes a perf hotspot — not needed today.
Minor DX: the topojson fetch has no abort or retry; an offline reload silently leaves the 'Trazando el mapa…' loader forever. Consider showing an error state after timeout. Low priority.
context_for_next_testing_agent: WorldMapSection lives in HomePage.jsx after <EmotionalIntro/>. Selectors: home-world-map, world-map-morocco, world-map-morocco-label, world-map-cta. Topojson at /geo/countries-110m.json (200 OK). Map uses geoNaturalEarth1().fitSize([1000,560]) with viewBox tightly cropped to landmass bounds + PAD=26 — that is what guarantees the 2.160 aspect ratio is preserved and labels never get squished. Ocean labels are HTML overlays positioned via percentage of the viewBox; hidden under md breakpoint by design. Compass rose hidden under sm by design. All three click targets navigate via pathFor(lang,'whatToSee') → ES: /que-ver-en-Marruecos.
